title: LProp: Propagating Latent Uncertainty through Evidence-Conditioned Belief Revision in LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.23564v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: When LLM agents pass intermediate judgments downstream without uncertainty, later decisions may treat tentative assumptions as facts. Effective uncertainty propagation must preserve information for correction and update inherited beliefs as new evidence arrives. Yet scalar scores omit information needed for revision, while detailed descriptions and reflection incur additional costs. We introduce Latent Uncertainty, a latent-space estimator that preserves uncertainty-relevant information without lengthy descriptions. Building on this, we propose LProp (Latent Uncertainty Propagation), which revises inherited answer distributions using latent representations and new evidence without additional trajectory sampling. We evaluate both methods across multiple-choice, yes/no, open-ended question answering, and mathematical reasoning tasks. Our approach outperforms baselines on most metrics, while LProp achieves the lowest mean inference-token us

translated_title: LProp：在LLM智能体中通过基于证据的信念修正传播潜在不确定性
translated_abstract: 当LLM智能体在不携带不确定性信息的情况下将中间判断传递给下游时，后续决策可能会把暂时性的假设当作事实。有效的不确定性传播必须保留可供修正的信息，并在新证据到来时更新继承的信念。然而，标量分数会遗漏修正所需的信息，而详细的描述和反思机制则会带来额外成本。我们提出了潜在不确定性，这是一种在潜在空间中保留与不确定性相关信息、而无需冗长描述的估计方法。在此基础上，我们提出了LProp（潜在不确定性传播），该方法利用潜在表示和新证据来修正继承的答案分布，无需额外的轨迹采样。我们在选择题、是非题、开放式问答和数学推理任务上对两种方法进行了评估。我们的方法在大多数指标上优于基线，同时LProp实现了最低的平均推理token使用量。
tldr: 论文提出LProp方法，通过在潜在空间中估计并传播不确定性信息，使LLM智能体能够在新证据到来时修正继承的信念，从而在不增加冗长描述或额外采样成本的情况下实现有效的不确定性传播。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes LProp, which estimates and propagates uncertainty in latent space so that LLM agents can revise inherited beliefs as new evidence arrives, avoiding the costs of lengthy descriptions or additional trajectory sampling.
